title: Pay fees and manage your debt payment plan with myDebts
summary: Use the myDebts online service to set up a payment plan for outstanding debts owed to various NSW Government agencies.
intro:
Revenue NSW recovers outstanding debts on behalf of TAFE NSW, Transport for NSW (TfNSW E-Toll), some local council fees, icare, WaterNSW, Service NSW and other NSW Government agencies.

### Using the myDebts online service

If you’ve received a fee notice or a debt notice for fees and services from a NSW Government agency, you can use the myDebts online service to set up a payment plan to pay your outstanding debts.

With myDebts you can:

If you started a payment plan before setting up myDebts, you can add your debt account to myDebts to view your progress.

If you receive a new fee notice or debt notice after setting up your payment plan, you can either:
who_can_apply: Outstanding debts issued by Revenue NSW on behalf of TAFE NSW, Transport for NSW (TfNSW E-Toll), some local council fees, icare, WaterNSW, Service NSW, and other NSW Government agencies.
Must be for personal or sole trader accounts only.
Cannot be used for business debts.
what_you_need: The payment reference number from your Revenue NSW fee or debt notice (found in the ‘How to pay’ section).
Your bank account, Visa, or Mastercard details.
Details from two identity documents (e.g., Australian driver licence, Medicare card, passport). The name on these documents must match the name on your fee or debt notice.

more_info.text: do not have a copy of your notice
need help with setting up your payment plan.
include any late fees in your payment
you may receive a fee notice for additional overdue payment costs.
If you’re having financial or legal issues, you can access free financial and legal advice.
If you are making a payment after the due date shown on the fee reminder notice:
To make a payment without setting up a payment plan, go to myDebts and select 'Pay now'.
To change any details on your myDebts record, contact Revenue NSW.

faqs.q: What types of debts can I use myDebts for?
faqs.a: myDebts can be used for outstanding debts issued by Revenue NSW on behalf of TAFE NSW, Transport for NSW (TfNSW E-Toll), some local council fees, icare, WaterNSW, Service NSW, and other NSW Government agencies. Note that myDebts cannot be used for business debts.

faqs.q: Can I manage my debt payments if I already started a plan?
faqs.a: Yes, if you started a payment plan before setting up myDebts, you can add your debt account to myDebts to view your progress.

faqs.q: What do I need to set up a payment plan?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, the payment reference number from your fee or debt notice, your bank account or card details, and details from two identity documents.
